left.raw_text: The patient and/or the patient's parent/legal guardian

right.raw_text: is willing and able to provide signed informed consent.

left.raw_text: The patient has a confirmed GAA enzyme deficiency

right.raw_text: from skin, blood, or muscle tissue and/or 2 confirmed GAA gene mutations.

left.raw_text: Infant and toddler Pompe disease patients can be included in the study only under condition
that the trial-related blood loss (including any losses in the maneuver)

right.raw_text: will not exceed 3 percent of the total blood volume during a period of 4 weeks and will not exceed 1 percent at any single time.
